data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a favourable prior accident year claims development of GBP 11.1 million in 2018, resulting from lower than expected claims development across all lines of business. This represents a release of 2.78% of opening gross reserves. In 2018, the syndicate experienced gross incurred claims of GBP 12.9 million from Hurricanes Florence and Michael, with a net impact of GBP 7.4 million. Additionally, the Marine Project Sassi loss resulted in a gross loss of GBP 18.1 million and a net loss of GBP 1.5 million for the syndicate.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable prior accident year claims development
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 11.1m is stated as 'Favourable prior accident year claims development' in the narrative. It is not explicitly stated as gross or net. The gross claims development triangle indicates a strengthening of GBP 30.89m for prior years, which contradicts the narrative. The net claims development triangle also indicates a strengthening of GBP 35.004m. Given the explicit narrative statement, it is used as the primary source for PYD, but its gross/net nature is ambiguous and it contradicts the claims development triangles. No detailed gross premium mix by line of business was found in a table format; only qualitative descriptions and growth figures were available.
